compatNotice.title: This page can't display properly
compatNotice.desc: Your browser is too old to load this page's styles correctly. The page below is unstyled on purpose — it is showing you what users on outdated browsers see.
compatNotice.reqIOS: iPad / iPhone: update to iOS 16.4 or later
compatNotice.reqAndroid: Android: update Chrome or Edge to 111+
compatNotice.reqDesktop: Desktop: Windows 10/11 + Chrome 111, Safari 16.4, or Firefox 128
compatNotice.how: iPad / iPhone: Settings → General → Software Update. Android: update Chrome in Play Store.
